Study in America

在美国留学 · 227 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Nannan’s father runs an enterprise near the Ming Tombs that sells batteries and drills to the Daqing Oilfield. Hoping to gain the qualifications to help manage the business, Nannan made extensive preparations. Once she had her visa, she left her home country to study in America. Having reached her destination, she settled in an inn recommended by the travel agent.

2Nannan felt that she had always done well in China. But she had to acknowledge it was not easy to adjust herself to the new academic requirements, which differed from those in China. Though she was occupied with lectures and seminars day in and day out, her tutors still criticised the essays she drafted. As for her routine life, she felt that it was hard to fit in, too. For example, she found English idioms difficult to understand. And it was hard to find good Chinese food, though several cafeterias served an abundant selection of other dishes. In addition, she had to wait in a queue early for the minibus that took her to school and it was usually so cold that she felt numb. What bothered her most was that no one apologised when a shopkeeper’s dog barked in its cage and disturbed her sleep.

3Luckily, her parents reassured her by videophone. She soon learned to manage on her own and eventually earned her bachelor’s degree.

高考英语3500词 · 35中文译文

在美国留学

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1楠楠的父亲在明十三陵附近经营一家企业，向大庆油田销售电池和钻机。为了有资格帮忙管理这家企业，楠楠做了不少准备，拿到签证后离开祖国，去美国留学。到了目的地，她住进了旅行社推荐的一家小旅馆。

2楠楠觉得，自己在国内一向表现不错。但她不得不承认，美国的学业要求与国内不同，适应起来并不容易。她天天忙着上课、参加研讨会，写出的论文还是常被导师指出问题。日常生活也很难适应。比如，她觉得英语里的习语很难懂。虽然可以在许多食堂里挑到不少替代菜品，想吃到可口的中餐还是很难。她得一大早排队等去学校的小巴，天气常冷得让她手脚发麻。最让她心烦的是，店主关在笼里的狗叫个不停，吵得她睡不好，却没有人向她道歉。

3好在父母通过视频通话安慰她。她很快学会独立生活，最后顺利拿到了学士学位。
